description:
The place where companion dogs who left before their humans go – Puppy Star. Here, they say one year is like one day. Nine-year-old Tori arrives at this Puppy Star. In this unfamiliar place without family, teachers and friends welcome Tori warmly. According to the teacher, if he sleeps for 100 nights, he can meet his family again. Can Tori, who misses his family from the moment he arrives, manage to spend 100 nights well?
